title: Netflix Movies and TV Shows EDA
description: Comprehensive exploratory data analysis of the Netflix catalog — cleaning, country and genre analysis, ratings, release trends, and duration patterns.
businessProblem: Explore what the Netflix catalog reveals about content strategy — which countries, genres, and ratings dominate, and how the catalog has shifted over time.
workflow: Clean the dataset and remove duplicate entries
Handle missing values across cast, country, and rating fields
Engineer features to separate movies from TV show durations
Analyze content by country and genre
Visualize findings and summarize business insights
results: US-produced titles and the Drama/Comedy genres dominate the catalog; content additions accelerated sharply in the years leading up to the dataset's cutoff.
lessonsLearned: The `country` and `cast` fields required careful multi-value parsing before any group-level analysis was reliable.
